correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed uniform recursive-parent coupling. Holding all other parents fixed, forcing P_t=j changes final path length by mean n/t times (1+H_{j-1}-H_{t-1}); parent-choice indicator probability 1/(t-1) gives n/[t(t-1)] times that factor. Summing t yields C_{n,j}=n/j-1+H_{n-1}-H_{j-1}-n sum_{s=j}^{n-1}s^{-2}. Adjacent difference (n-j(j+1))/(j^2(j+1)) first rises then falls, with C_{n,1}<0, C_{n,n-1}>0 and C_{n,n}=0, implying unique sign crossing. Expansion log(n/j)-n/(2j^2)+lower terms and substitution j=a sqrt(n/log n) yields sign at a=1. Exact independent enumeration of all (n-1)! recursively grown trees for n=3..7 checked each rational covariance. Infinite theorem follows from identities, not finite enumeration.
